LESSON: PLAIN SCALE DRAWING

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Communication in Pre-Technical Studies
Topic 2.3: Plain Scale Drawing

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Plain Scale Drawing
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What is the importance of drawing figures to scale?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe the features of a plain scale used in drawing
2. draw plane figures to a given scale
3. appreciate the use of plain scale drawing in the work environment

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: describe the features of a plain scale used in drawing

Teach

• Listen/read the idea.

• Then do Try this.

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: draw plane figures to a given scale

▸ Skill 3: appreciate the use of plain scale drawing in the work environment

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: describe the features of a plain scale used in drawing
• Model 2: draw plane figures to a given scale
• Model 3: appreciate the use of plain scale drawing in the work environment

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: describe the features of a plain scale used in drawing
2. Practise: draw plane figures to a given scale
3. Practise: appreciate the use of plain scale drawing in the work environment

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Plain Scale Drawing.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What is the importance of drawing figures to scale?
2. How are plane figures drawn to scale?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• describe the features of a plain scale used in drawing
• draw plane figures to a given scale
• appreciate the use of plain scale drawing in the work environment
